preToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolName'); echo "Checking tool: $TOOL" >&2; if [[ "$TOOL" == *"dangerous"* ]]; then echo '{"permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "Tool contains dangerous operations"}'; else echo '{"permissionDecision": "allow"}'; fi
preToolUse.powershell: $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Checking tool: $($input.toolName)"; if ($input.toolName -like '*dangerous*') { @{permissionDecision='deny'; permissionDecisionReason='Tool contains dangerous operations'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } else { @{permissionDecision='allow'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }
